evidence.quote: Dopo aver ricevuto la Lettera di Idoneità all’Immatricolazione (Letter of Eligibility for Enrollment), devono pre-iscriversi entro le scadenze stabilite dal Ministero e dall’Università di Siena attraverso la piattaforma Universitaly.

notes: Tuition is left out: the pages do not state a single EUR amount for a full-time Bachelor student from outside the EU living abroad for the current academic year; the programme page only points to a general university page (www.unisi.it/tasse) and the Master's-level manifest refers to a regulation by ISEE band. No intakes are included because the only dated deadlines on the pages refer to the 2013-2014 pre-enrolment for non-EU students or to the 2008-2009 Engineering faculty, not to this programme, and no undated recurring international deadline is given for it.

note.fr: Un test d'accès obligatoire mais non sélectif est prévu; il sert à vérifier la préparation de base et peut entraîner des obligations formatives supplémentaires à remplir durant la première année.
note.en: A compulsory but non-selective entrance test is required; it verifies basic preparation and may lead to additional formative obligations to be fulfilled in the first year.

evidence.quote: devono partecipare a un test di accesso obbligatorio ma non preclusivo per l’immatricolazione. Tale test è volto a verificare la preparazione di base e a conoscere gli eventuali obblighi formativi aggiuntivi da colmare entro il primo anno di corso.
